name: SpecStream Browser
description: A real Chromium browser in the cloud for your agent: open pages, click, type, read and take screenshots, with no browser to install. Sessions cost $0.10 an hour charged by the second, and $1 per 1,000 steps.

apiKey.description: SpecStream API key, or a SecretRef. Falls back to the SPECSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable.

timeoutSeconds.description: The most seconds one browser session runs. Defaults to 300. The model can ask for less per session and never more.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: A session ends after this many seconds without a step. Defaults to 300.

allowedDomains.description: Hosts the browser may open, such as example.com or *.example.com. Empty allows every public host. The model can narrow the list per session and never add a host.

blockMedia.description: true skips images, video, audio and fonts, so pages load faster. Screenshots then show no pictures.

apiKey.label: SpecStream API key
apiKey.help: Create a key under Agents & API in your SpecStream workspace. Falls back to the SPECSTREAM_API_KEY environment variable.

timeoutSeconds.label: Longest session (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: A browser session ends after this many seconds at the latest. The model can ask for less and never more. Default 300.

idleTimeoutSeconds.label: Idle wait (seconds)
idleTimeoutSeconds.help: A session ends after this many seconds without a step. Default 300.

allowedDomains.label: Allowed hosts
allowedDomains.help: Hosts the browser may open, such as example.com or *.example.com. Empty allows every public host.

blockMedia.label: Skip pictures and media
blockMedia.help: Pages load faster. Screenshots then show no pictures.
